title: Cost model source provenance + calibration review (WIP)
body:
Purpose and quick summary:
This doc captures my notes while tracing the inputs to the Optimize cost model (v4) back to source systems and calibration logic. Objective is to produce a compact provenance table and a prioritized list of outstanding questions that need finance sign-off before we lock the model for the public-facing pricing proposal. WIP — many items flagged for owners and follow-ups below.

1) Inventory of primary data sources (where numbers currently come from)
- Raw usage: telemetry-export:prod (BigQuery) — table: token_usage_v2 (owner: Aisha). Daily aggregations used in tab "raw-usage" of cost_model_v4.xlsx.
- Infra pricing: cloud-rate-catalog (internal spreadsheet, tab infra-prices) — uses committed discounts and spot assumptions (owner: Ravi). Questions on how Reserved vs OnDemand is blended.
- GPU amortization: infra-capex-model (sheet) — amortization windows 24/36/48 mo depending on hardware class (owner: Claire).
- Quantization/Perf delta: bench-results (S3 CSV + bench dashboard) — per-model relative speedups for int8 and fp16 (owner: Applied ML leads).
- Support and SRE opex: finance allocation workbook (Finance team) — currently pro-rated by cluster-hours (owner: Dana Lee).

2) Noted calibration heuristics (where we adjusted raw numbers)
- Batching speedup multiplier: applied 1.25x token/sec improvement for racks with dynamic batching enabled. Source: serving-runtime benchmarks dated 2024-08-14. Need explicit bench PR linking.
- KV cache hit assumed at 12% for chat workloads; derived from sampled session prefixes (sample window: 2024-07 to 2024-09). This heavily impacts token cost for streaming chat.
- Embedding average length set to 512 dims => per-vector compute cost derived from embedding model perf bench; we currently assume 1.1x baseline CPU preprocessing overhead.

3) Gaps and sanity checks we ran
- Currency and regional pricing: infra-prices sheet only contains US West and EU West. APAC multipliers are rough (1.2x) — needs validation from cloud invoices (Ravi to pull region-level invoice extract).
- Spot availability assumption: model assumes 15% spot usage across dedicated pools; finance noted actual spot use has been >25% in some tickets. Need to correct expected cash flow impact.
- Model mix by customer tier: hosted vs dedicated usage split pulled from signup cohort join (BigQuery). Cohort derivation logic unclear: which timeframe and retention filter used. Aisha to add SQL snippet.

4) Sensitivity knobs we intend to show in the deck
- GPU amortization window: 24/36/48 mo — pivot to show cost per token impact. Current delta between 24 and 48 months = ~7–9% unit change.
- KV cache hit range: 5%/12%/25% — shows up to 18% variation in token cost for chat.
- Batch size / latency SLO trade: default batching assumed 1.5x throughput at median latency 80ms; if we tighten latency SLO to 50ms throughput drops ~20% in bench.

5) Specific finance sign-off items (short checklist)
- Confirm blended cloud rate: which discount tranche applies to hosted API pool vs Dedicated (Dana).
- Approve amortization policy for new GPU class A100-80GB (Claire/Dana).
- Confirm allocation method for SRE/Support opex — currently pro-rated by cluster-hours; Finance to confirm if headcount-based allocation preferred.
- Validate spot-commit assumption (Ravi/Dana): change from 15% to 25% if invoices show higher.

6) Proposed calibration steps (minimal set to move to final)
- Short: attach raw SQL and query hashes for every BigQuery source used in model (owner: Aisha) — deadline 2024-12-02.
- Medium: replace APAC region multipliers with invoice-derived regional rates (owner: Ravi) — deadline 2024-12-09.
- Medium: run amortization sensitivity for 24/36/48 mo and produce a one-pager with baseline recommendation (owner: Claire) — deadline 2024-12-16.
- Long: rerun benchmark suite for top 5 model variants with the exact inference runtime flags (int8 vs fp16) we plan to publish — owner: Applied ML — ETA 2025-01-03.

7) Open questions to resolve in the next review cycle
- Which cloud discounting policy should be used for product-led hosted customers vs enterprise dedicated reservations? (Finance)
- Do we apply a margin buffer in published unit economics (e.g., +10% markup) to absorb usage volatility? If yes, how do we present this in the public pricing doc? (Product + Finance)
- Should KV-cache savings be shown as an operational improvement (lower unit cost) or as a product-level feature benefit (presented separately from base per-token pricing)?

8) Risk notes (things that materially change numbers)
- New GPU class with higher perf leads to lower unit cost but increases capex and amortization concentration — can swing committed-cost profile.
- A change in expected spot availability (down to 5% during supply crunch) increases marginal unit cost ~6–12% depending on model mix.

9) Action items (owner — ETA)
- Aisha: include SQL snippets and BigQuery table schema references under "raw-usage" tab — 2024-12-02.
- Ravi: pull region-level invoice CSVs and update infra-prices APAC multipliers — 2024-12-09.
- Claire: finalize amortization recommendation one-pager with rationale — 2024-12-16.
- Dana (Finance): confirm allocation method for SRE and headcount vs cluster-hours tradeoff — 2024-12-11.
- Applied ML lead (cc Claire): run targeted bench for model variants (int8/fp16) using production runtime flags and attach raw bench CSVs — 2025-01-03.

10) Final note and proposed meeting cadence
- Recommend a 45-minute calibration review on 2024-12-17 with owners present (Aisha, Ravi, Claire, Dana, Applied ML rep). The goal is to lock the baseline assumptions and finalize the sensitivity scenarios for the pricing deck.

If anything here looks off or if you want a narrower export (provenance-only table), call it out in comments. I purposely left the SQL references light — will attach full query text in the next iteration.

-- Marco
(working notes; not final)
